title: Gravestone Curios API Compat Backport
description: Added compatibility between Gravestone mod and Curios API! Backport for 1.16.5
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64b6b23bdba8189f53a73cfbcb38a0a765028183.png)

This project is an official backport of the original [Gravestone Mod X Curios API Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/gravestone-x-curios-api-compat) for Minecraft version **1.16.5**.

### About the Mod
The original mod serves as a compatibility bridge between two popular mods: **Gravestone Mod** and **Curios API**. By default, when a player dies, items in the Curios slots (like rings, necklaces, or backpacks) might not be saved correctly or could drop on the ground instead of going into the grave. 

This add-on solves that issue by creating full integration: it ensures that upon your death, all items equipped in your Curios slots are safely stored inside your gravestone. When you break the grave, your Curios items are automatically put back directly into their respective slots, making the recovery process seamless and hassle-free.

### What's New in this Port?
* **1.16.5 Backport:** Brought all core features of the original compatibility mod to Minecraft 1.16.5.
* **Modpack Integration:** This specific version was created and optimized for the [Endless Rise: Remastered](https://github.com/BMProjects-Development/Endless-Rise-Remastered) modpack to enhance the gameplay experience and prevent item loss, but it works perfectly in any other 1.16.5 environment.

---

# FAQ

Q: Can I use this mod in my modpack?  
A: Yes, absolutely! Feel free to include this mod in any modpack.
